exposure: Diabetes status (with DM vs without DM)
outcome: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
cohort: Mothers who received maternity service in three hospitals and four health centers in Southern Ethiopia
finding: Diabetes mellitus among pregnant mothers is associated with increased risk of pre-term delivery, macrosomia and maternal complications of pre-eclampsia and caesarian delivery.
mod_finding: Mothers with DM were 2.9 times more likely to be delivered by caesarean section than non-diabetic mothers.
